items.question: What is UGC and how can it help my brand?
items.answer: UGC stands for user-generated content: videos that look like they were made by a regular person, not by the brand. Creators like me film them for ads and social. Because they don’t feel like a commercial, people trust them more and keep watching.

items.question: What kinds of videos do you make?
items.answer: Ads for TikTok and Meta, spokesperson videos, reviews, product demos, lifestyle content, and B-roll. All vertical, in Spanish, English, or both.

items.question: Do you post the content on your own social media?
items.answer: No. I send you the files and you post them on your own channels: your social accounts, your website, or your landing pages. Running them as paid ads needs a separate license. I don’t post anything on my accounts unless we agree on a brand ambassador deal.

items.question: How does the process work?
items.answer: You tell me what you need and I send you a proposal. Once we agree on the brief, I film, edit, and deliver. If I need the product, you ship it to me first. It’s all remote.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: It depends on the type of video, how many you need, and how complex the project is. Message me on WhatsApp or Fiverr with what you have in mind and I’ll send you a quote.

items.question: Are revisions included?
items.answer: Yes. Every project includes 1 or 2 rounds of revisions for edits, pacing, or on-screen text. If you need something bigger, like a reshoot, we quote that separately.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Usually 3 to 5 business days after I receive the product and we confirm the brief. If you have a tight deadline, tell me upfront and we’ll make it work.

items.question: What usage rights does the brand get?
items.answer: Every project includes the rights to post the videos organically on your channels. If you also want to run them as paid ads, that needs a separate license, which we quote together.

items.question: What kinds of brands do you usually work with?
items.answer: Mostly brands speaking to Spanish-speaking audiences in the US, plus teams in Spain and Latin America. I also make English videos when a project needs them. I film everything remotely from Medellín.

items.question: What languages do you work in?
items.answer: Spanish and English. Spanish is my native language, so I don’t need a script and there’s no length limit. In English I work from your script, up to 65 words per video, so it sounds natural.
